sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate is deterministically valid and faithfully targets frames, ice stringers, and web frames; requires effective-cross-section section modulus and shear area with the canonical datatypes and units; and correctly places classification-society calculation evidence at the non-normal-member boundary.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Applicability is too narrow: the requirement covers frames, stringers, and web frames governed by 4.4–4.6, but the shape targets only nltl:iceStringer. Locate the canonical classes for each covered member category and target all of them directly (without ship/component indirection), applying the effective-cross-section, section-modulus, shear-area, orientation, and conditional classification-society-evidence constraints consistently.

Add the missing target for frames using the canonical frame class located by the vocabulary matcher; the requirement applies to frames, stringers, and web frames, not only ice stringers and web frames. Restructure the section-modulus and shear-area constraints so they are explicitly tied to the linked effective member cross section (for example, constrain those quantities within the sh:node reached by hasEffectiveMemberCrossSection), rather than independently requiring unrelated values on the member. Retain the conditional classification-society evidence requirement for members whose memberNormalToPlating value is false, without asserting numerical compliance or exact decimal equality where no verified formula is supplied.

Candidate is deterministically valid and faithfully targets frames, ice stringers, and web frames; requires effective-cross-section section modulus and shear area with the canonical datatypes and units; and correctly places classification-society calculation evidence at the non-normal-member boundary.
